integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof and executable standard-library finite checks are supplied. No independent mathematical audit, publication-priority certification, or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The invariant is proved complete within finite ordinal sums of antichains, not among all finite posets. The prior literature establishes the general Peirce law and its finite no-gap result; uncatalogued equivalent enumerations may exist. The included finite exhaustive tests are bounded corroboration and do not replace the symbolic proof.
title: Peirce-right-fiber spectra reconstruct finite weak-order Heyting frames
